reviews.text6b6tTheServerThatFinallyConvincedMeT: 6b6t.. the server that finally convinced me that I was going to be playing minecraft for a long time, I got Prime rank in 2023 thanks to a friend. Having more than 5 homes gives me the freedom of moving around the server much quicker than most players. The price for prime rank is quite nice, especially for people who dont know if they want to continue playing forever or not. The visibility in chat is nice, I can easily promote my stuff thanks to people being able to see my chats. Prime rank's cooldowns still feel like forever, I wish those were a bit lower. Overall 6b6t with Prime rank is an amazing experience, I'd probably recommend it over Elite rank especially if you don't care for creating hotspots.
reviews.text6b6tIsAGreatServerILovePlayingIt: 6b6t is a great server! I love playing it with my friends and occasionally live-streaming my time on the server. I recently bought the Prime rank on the server, and for 16 euros it's a steal! It's really helpful in increasing the amount of homes I can have, and I really like how it highlights my chat messages. Speaking of homes, I really like that this server has a homes plugin. It really helps me not get lost from my base, and makes me more willing to visit spawn, knowing I can easily return home anytime. This server is goated, 5 stars for sure!
reviews.iReallyEnjoyTheNumberOfHomesHavingThat: I really enjoy the number of homes — having that many homes defines the server for me; playstyle would be very different without them. Cosmetics like /sit are fun when hanging out with friends, and chat color is useful (I'd like more than one color, but not a rainbow). Discord role: nothing special to add. Prime price is very good (5/5). The jump from Elite to Apex feels large; an intermediate rank/price between Elite and Apex would be nice. Sorry for any mistakes, English isn't my first language.
reviews.iLove6bVeryMuchAndEnjoyPlayingIt: I love 6b very much and enjoy playing it; it's by far the best anarchy server out there. Playing with friends is wonderful — mobility using tp and /home encourages progress. Hotspots help players get out further and encourage PvP. Chat features like chatcolor, balloons, and /sit make the server more fun and allow for interesting screenshots and content. I give 6b 5 stars.
reviews.iLikeTheAbilityToHave12HomesBecause: I like the ability to have 12 homes because it lets me teleport to multiple stashes and bases including spawn; increasing it to 15 homes would improve the experience since I already have around 12. The 300s (5m) cooldown is nice for transferring items between stashes/bases, though I wish it were a bit lower. Server activity has increased a lot since I joined in 2023. Overall, Prime as a permanent rank is extremely worth it; I give it 4/5 stars.
reviews.homesAmountMyMostUsefulFeatureICanHave: Homes amount: my most useful feature — I can have homes for bases and stashes. Although the default homes level is quite low I enjoy the upgrade. Visibility in chat: my name has a great color and my text is white, much more noticeable which I like. Whether the price was worth it: $20 before taxes is a bit steep; I'd prefer a cheaper tier (white text, no prefix, +3 homes, colors in anvils, no Discord role) for about $8. 3/5 stars.
reviews.theRanksAreGoodMyNameNowPopsIn: The ranks are good — my name now pops in chat which is great for getting noticed. The lower cooldowns are a game changer and more homes are super useful. I was a little iffy about the price but getting this for life feels totally worth it; no regrets. Best rank to buy is Prime 😱 I'd rate it 4/5.
reviews.eliteLifetimeRankWasWorthItLifetimeAcces: Elite lifetime rank was worth it — lifetime access and cheaper than the monthly option. Prime could get a small cosmetic like one balloon or /hat so they're not left out (I understand you need to make money). Less cooldowns are nice, but voting already gives a similar benefit for free. Hotspots should be limited so they're not placed inside 5kx5k areas of the Nether, Overworld, or End to prevent new players from escaping too easily. Overall my purchase was 5/5.
reviews.myExperienceWithEliteHasBeenVeryGoodSo: My experience with Elite has been very good so far. I don't even have to think about if I have any homes left, which greatly improves the in-game experience. The /hotspot command is useful for PvP with friends. Since active APEX and Elite ULTRA players are low, anvil color codes should be available to Elite as a cosmetic. Overall, Elite is a great rank for active players and a steal for a permanent rank.
reviews.iStarted6b6tWithoutARankAndLaterReceived: I started 6b6t without a rank and later received multiple ranks; Elite is great. As a clan owner it's valuable to have a rank so messages are visible. I appreciate the ranked chat on Discord. Hotspots are cooler now that I can place them, and the lowered cooldown is a massive plus. One complaint: lowest ranks often miss key things (VIP felt similar to unranked). Also, when someone anonymously gifted me Prime Ultra I had access to the advertising channel but lost those permissions after gaining Elite.
reviews.theHomesAmountOnEliteOrHigherIsMore: The homes amount on Elite or higher is more than enough. Cosmetics like /balloon give color to the server. Playing with friends keeps 6b fun. Buildermode is great but increases render distance, not simulation distance. If you play on 6b for longer than a year, the purchase is definitely worth it — I rate mine 4.5 stars.
reviews.eliteRankIsActuallyBetterThanIThoughtWhe: Elite rank is actually better than I thought. When I bought it I expected just colored text, but it feels like entering a club for special people. Playing with friends is great — low ping and high TPS. Discord ranked channels are much more active; it's like a club (try 🚬-cigar-club-🚬). My favorite thing is lower cooldowns — /tpa and /home are much better than unranked and let you move between bases in minutes. Chat colors help you stand out (pro tip: custom chat mods or modded clients make it even better). 5/5 Stars
reviews.hotspotCreateYouCanCreateHotspotsWhenNoO: /hotspot create: you can create hotspots when no other hotspots are active. Do you have more than 3 homes? with elite rank you can have 30 homes which will be enough for all of your bases. Are you tired of nobody seeing you? With elite rank you can have a chat color that stands out and more people will see you! Are you a builder but the render distance is too low? Use /buildermode to look farther! And for all of that and more for only 49.99? I suggest you get it also.
reviews.gettingEliteOn6b6tWasAGreatChoiceThe: Getting Elite on 6b6t was a great choice. The extra homes help a lot for multiple bases with friends and /buildermode helps view your entire base. I like the /hat and /balloons commands — they're fun to mess around with. Hotspot was the main reason I got Elite because I PvP a lot and hotspots are perfect for PvP. Standing out in chat and reduced cooldowns are must-haves for active players. Discord roles (like #game-suggestions) make the community feel included. Lifetime rank means no recurring payments — perks are worth the price. 5/5 stars.
reviews.myExperienceIn6bWithAndWithoutARank: My experience in 6b with and without a rank has been pretty good, but a rank improves things — mainly the home limit so I don't need to delete homes, and /hotspot which lets you make events. Cosmetics like balloons and /sit are fun, and chat color makes messages stand out. I rate my experience with a rank 4.5/5 and recommend a rank if you plan to stay long-term.
reviews.iHavePlayedThisServerForThreeYearsFirst: I have played this server for three years — first 2 years without a rank. I got Prime for more homes, then Elite for hotspot and even more homes, and faster cooldowns. This is the only time I have ever spent money on a Minecraft server. It was 100% worth it, especially for the fun I have had using /hotspot. Bonus /sit is based and I like having a balloon.
reviews.theHomesAmountIsExcellentTheMostUsefulFe: The homes amount is excellent — the most useful feature for me. Chatcolor is nice to stand out, visibility in chat is a plus, and lower cooldowns help (though rapid command use can be a bit tedious). Playing with friends is fun and the Discord role adds authority. Price is reasonable at about $16 and worth it. Final rating: 4 stars.
reviews.iThinkThatTheApexLifetimeRankWasWorth: I think that the Apex lifetime rank was worth buying. The 100 homes perk is useful for building and the amount of bases/stashes I can set a home for, and the cosmetics like /hat, /balloons, /sit, and /skin make the server genuinely more fun. The Apex Discord role is a nice bonus too with all the extra channels and permissions. Builder mode, hotspots, and all the color options in anvils/chat just make it feel like the full rank package. 5/5 stars from me.
reviews.afterWinningPrimeInAGiveawayIUpgradedTo: After winning Prime in a giveaway I upgraded to Apex. The feature I use most is the increased homes — it helps track stashes, bases, and locations. Lower cooldowns for tpa and /home are extremely helpful (from 15 minutes down to ~15 seconds). I don't use cosmetics much, but chat color helps me stand out from new players begging for kits. The Discord role is great for getting news quickly. Because I play so little, Apex wasn't the best price for me; Elite would have been better. I recommend Apex only to players who play ~10 hours a week.
reviews.text6b6tIsPureChaosAndPureFun6b6tIs: 6b6t is Pure Chaos — and Pure Fun! 6b6t is the kind of server where something is always happening. From fighting at active hotspots to teaming up with strangers who become friends, every session brings a new story. I got the lifetime Apex rank, and it's worth it just to support the server and stay committed long-term. The higher render distance and Builder Mode make it way easier to plan large-scale builds and enjoy the landscape in full detail. Building huge bases, exploring ruins, and surviving ambushes with friends has made it one of the wildest Minecraft experiences out there. If you're into unfiltered anarchy and community-driven gameplay, 6b6t is the place—and Apex is a solid way to show you're in it for the long haul.
